channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Jonas Valanciunas | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Jonas Valanciunas from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Nikola Jokic on Jonas Valanciunas, Aaron Gordon
item.description:
Nikola Jokic on potentially playing double-big with Jonas Valanciunas (asked and answered as Aaron Gordon was walking by):

“Why not? I’m sick of AG. I cannot play with him anymore. So we need to change him. We’re not gonna change me.”

Nikola Jokic on Jonas Valanciunas, Aaron Gordon, Sep 30, 2025. Source: x.com.

item.title: Ben Tenzer on Jonas Valanciunas
item.description:
Denver Nuggets executive Ben Tenzer on Jonas Valanciunas:

“We’ve had great conversations with him, and there’s been nothing but healthy conversations in terms of him honoring his contract and him excited to be a Nugget.”

Ben Tenzer on Jonas Valanciunas, Jul 18, 2025. Source: x.com.

item.title: David Adelman on DeMarcus Cousins, Nikola Jokic, Jonas Valanciunas
item.description:
Adelman on Jonas Valanciunas:

“Point center. You can play combo guards, you don't need a lead PG, you can play 5-out offense, off the elbow, post him up. He's such a skilled player... 1st time we have our backup with a similar skillset to Nikola Jokic beside DeMarcus Cousins.”

David Adelman on DeMarcus Cousins, Nikola Jokic, Jonas Valanciunas, Jul 11, 2025. Source: Bluesky.

item.title: Linas Kleiza on Jonas Valanciunas, Domantas Sabonis
item.description:
During conversations, Kleiza wondered if he had made a mistake by not going to the United States earlier to meet the country's stars.

“Maybe I should have told Jonas (Valanciunas) and Domantas (Sabonis) earlier how important they were. It seemed to me that it was obvious that this team was theirs. Maybe that was my mistake,”

Linas Kleiza on Jonas Valanciunas, Domantas Sabonis, Apr 8, 2025. Source: BasketNews.

item.title: Kyle Kuzma on Jonas Valanciunas
item.description:
Kyle Kuzma on his reaction to the Wizards signing Jonas Valanciunas this summer:

“That we're not going to be the worst defensive rebounding team in the league anymore.”

Kyle Kuzma on Jonas Valanciunas, Sep 30, 2024. Source: x.com.

item.title: Mark Daigneault on Jonas Valanciunas
item.description:
Clemente Almanza:Mark Daigneault on Jonas Valanciunas:

“You never want to concede anything. You don’t want to hand out points or rebounds to anybody. We have to keep the cost-benefit equation tilted in our favor… The minute the cost outweighs the benefit that’s when you have to adjust.”

Mark Daigneault on Jonas Valanciunas, Apr 23, 2024. Source: Twitter @CAlmanza1007.

item.title: Chet Holmgren on Jonas Valanciunas
item.description:
Clemente Almanza:Chet Holmgren on Jonas Valanciunas:

“I'm expecting him to be extremely physical throughout the seriesand we'll be prepared for that.”

Chet Holmgren on Jonas Valanciunas, Apr 20, 2024. Source: Twitter @CAlmanza1007.

item.title: Trey Murphy on Jonas Valanciunas, Trey Lyles
item.description:
Jim Eichenhofer:Trey Murphy on why he wasn’t fazed or concerned about a possible altercation breaking out between Jonas Valanciunas and Trey Lyles in Monday’s win:

“There wasn’t going to be anything happening. We all know who the big dog was in that fight.”

Trey Murphy on Jonas Valanciunas, Trey Lyles, Dec 5, 2023. Source: Twitter @Jim_Eichenhofer.

item.title: Taylor Jenkins on Jonas Valanciunas
item.description:
Memphis'Taylor Jenkins on importance of Jonas Valanciunas vs. #Pelicans:

“(New Orleans has) one of the best and one of the most physical frontcourts in the league. You're definitely going to need one of your most physical players to set the toneon both ends of the floor.”

Taylor Jenkins on Jonas Valanciunas, Feb 16, 2021. Source: Twitter @Jim_Eichenhofer.

item.title: Nick Nurse on Jonas Valanciunas
item.description:
Donatas Urbonas:Nick Nurse on Jonas Valanciunas:

“More Jonas stories... I obviously love Jonas. But I’m gonna try to kick his ass tomorrow (laughs).I don’t know if there was a guy that I spent as much time with and had a strong long relationship like him.”

Nick Nurse on Jonas Valanciunas, Sep 2, 2019. Source: Twitter @Urbodo.

item.title: Mike Conley on Jonas Valanciunas
item.description:
Omari Sanfoka II:Conley on Valanciunas being a good teammate:

“There's times he apologized to me in the huddle, like 'I should've set a better screen.' I'm like 'But you set a good screen.'”

Mike Conley on Jonas Valanciunas, Apr 11, 2019. Source: Twitter @omarisankofa.

item.title: Carmelo Anthony on Russell Westbrook, Jonas Valanciunas
item.description:
Fred Katz:Melo on staying on his back and trying to get a better angle during Russell Westbrook’s and Jonas Valanciunas’ handsiness last night:

“I still wanted to be in the middle of it but i was a bit too late... Nothing was gonna happen. So, keep my money.”

Carmelo Anthony on Russell Westbrook, Jonas Valanciunas, Dec 28, 2017. Source: Twitter @FredKatz.

item.title: Dwane Casey on Jonas Valanciunas
item.description:
Manny Navarro:Dwane Casey on Jonas Valanciunas:

“I don't he will play in Game 7. His ankle is nowhere close to being ready.”

Dwane Casey on Jonas Valanciunas, May 14, 2016. Source: Twitter @Manny_Navarro.

item.title: Dwane Casey on Jonas Valanciunas
item.description:
On Saturday, the Toronto Raptors rookie center, Jonas Valanciunas, scared head coach Dwane Casey and just about everyone else connected to the organization.

“It scared me because I was at the NBA head coaches meeting in Chicago and I get this email that he (Valanciunas) heard something pop,”

Dwane Casey on Jonas Valanciunas, Sep 24, 2012. Source: HoopsWorld.

item.title: Ryan Blake on Jonas Valanciunas
item.description:
“My feeling is that Valanciunas will pull out (of the draft) if he can't negotiate a buyout,”

Ryan Blake on Jonas Valanciunas, Jun 12, 2011. Source: News-Herald.
